title: REQ · Assets are preloaded, validated and fall back gracefully when missing
summary: Scene assets are planned from the manifest, and missing or dangling ones resolve to a fallback texture.
description: Context: assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts already offers loadManifestWithFallback, checkAssetRefs and FALLBACK_ASSET_ID, but nothing turns a scene's asset refs into a preload plan. Desired behavior: a preload planner validates every object asset ref against the manifest, lists assets to load and returns a fallback texture key for any missing ref. Expected: a missing asset never throws and the object renders with the fallback. Why: broken content must not crash the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given refs present in the manifest, when planning, then the plan lists each asset once to load
Given a ref absent from the manifest, when resolving, then the fallback texture key is returned and the ref is reported in missing
Given a ref whose texture failed to load, when resolving, then the fallback key is returned without throwing
Given duplicate refs, when planning, then each asset is loaded once
definition_of_done: Planner exported and used by WorldScene
